title: react33.config — react33Styles, react33I18n, react33Theme, react33Networking
description: Root schema for react33.config.json. Published by @react33/react-config. Optional $schema key, or associate via .vscode/settings.json (json.schemas).

$schema.description: Opcional si el editor ya asocia react33.config.json vía workspace (ver @react33/react-config). Si lo declarás: ./node_modules/@react33/react-config/react33.config.schema.json

react33Networking.description: Generated API registry and client hooks (@react33/react-networking). Paths are relative to react33.config.json.

output.description: Path for apis.generated.ts (createApiRegistry, apis, *Request). Overrides CLI default when --output is omitted.

hooksOutput.description: Optional path for the client hooks module. If omitted, derived from output (e.g. apis.client.generated.tsx next to apis.generated.ts).

apis.description: Map of API name -> { url, headers?, cache?, credentials? }.

react33OpenApi.description: OpenAPI 3.1+ codegen (@react33/react-networking). Paths relative to react33.config.json.

client.description: HTTP client overrides when apis.<scope> is omitted (OpenAPI-first). url comes from servers[0] + basePath.

validate.description: Runtime Zod validation for SDK params/response.

operations.description: Per operationId: fetchOnMount, verbose, initData, validate, security.

react33Persistence.description: Claves y modo de persistencia en browser compartidos por locale (react33I18n) y tema (react33Theme).

cookieName.description: Nombre de la cookie cuando el backend activo es cookie.

localStorageKey.description: Clave de localStorage cuando el backend activo es localStorage.

persistenceMode.description: Backend por defecto si la app soporta ambos.

persistenceEnvKey.description: Env var para sobreescribir persistenceMode (defaults: REACT33_I18N_PERSISTENCE / REACT33_THEME_PERSISTENCE). Debe exponerse al cliente: Vite envPrefix REACT33_; Next NEXT_PUBLIC_* + mismo nombre aquí. Ver docs/persistence-env-client.en.md. "" desactiva override.

allOf.description: Locale: convención de rutas y mensajes (ver @react33/react-i18n).

localesDirectory.description: Carpeta de módulos por idioma (relativa a react33.config.json).

urlLocalePattern.description: Regex (string) sobre pathname; primer grupo de captura = locale.

generatedTypesOutput.description: Ruta del módulo de tipos/constantes generado (p. ej. i18n.generated.ts).

generatedRuntimeOutput.description: Ruta del runtime SPA generado (Provider, hooks, persistencia).

allOf.description: Tema: opciones extra de escritura de cookie. defaultTheme suele venir de styles.meta generado.

cookieMaxAgeSeconds.description: Max-Age del cookie de tema (~1 año por defecto).

generatedRuntimeOutput.description: Ruta del runtime de tema generado (Provider, hooks, persistencia).

stylesGeneratedImport.description: Import relativo a styles.generated desde el archivo runtime (default ./styles.generated).

react33Styles.description: Paths are relative to the config file directory.

domainsOrder.description: Cascade order (file stems without .css). Overrides alphabetical discovery.

output.description: Output path for the generated .ts file.

excludeStems.description: Stems to skip when auto-discovering CSS files (ignored if domainsOrder is set).

banner.description: First line(s) of the generated TypeScript file.

verbose.description: Log resolved config, fromCss, domain order, and output path.

watch.description: Watch fromCss for changes and regenerate (same as CLI --watch). Use CLI --no-watch to force a one-off run when this is true.

metaSourceStem.description: Which CSS stem provides @theme meta (defaultTheme, cols). Default: tokens, else first domain.
